93:t_1:3.en: ～ Aboard the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ ～

93:t_1:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm $$ランド・トラビス$$, the wandering repairman from $$ビーター・サービス$$. You might know me better as $$ザ・ヒート$$.」

93:t_1:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Maybe I should introduce myself to you as the $$傷だらけの獅子$$'s $$リアクター$$.」

93:t_1:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アルト$$ and the others filled me in. You're the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$リアクター$$, huh?」

93:t_1:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, we're both $$リアクター$$s. I kinda knew the moment we met.」

93:t_1:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「Getting beaten by $$バルビエル$$ really shook you up, huh?」

93:t_1:15.en:
$n
「...How can I draw out the $$スフィア$$'s power...?」

93:t_1:17.en:
$n
「If I could do that, even $$バルビエル$$...」

93:t_1:20.en:
$$ランド$$
「Letting a $$スフィア$$ push you around never ends well. If you wanna beat $$バルビエル$$, find another way.」

93:t_1:22.en:
$$ランド$$
「You just gotta get stronger than him.」

93:t_1:24.en:
$$ランド$$
「You've finally got some fire in your eyes. Now we can have a real talk.」

93:t_1:25.en:
$$ランド$$
「If the guy $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ had his eye on kept moping around, I figured I'd have to beat some spirit into him.」

93:t_1:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah... We were traveling together until recently.」

93:t_1:28.en:
$$ランド$$
「He told me you'd save us.」

93:t_1:30.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ risked his life to save me. I want to repay him.」

93:t_1:31.en:
$n
「No... It isn't just $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I want to fight for everyone who helped me stay alive.」

93:t_1:32.en:
$$ランド$$
「You wanna repay your debts, huh... I like that.」

93:t_1:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whoa, don't expect too much. About all I can help with is fixing things and drinking.」

93:t_1:37.en:
$$ランド$$
「Guess you can't be my drinking buddy...」

93:t_1:38.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll pass on something someone who looked after me taught me when I was your age.」

93:t_1:42.en:
$$ランド$$
「What I'm gonna teach you is how to smile. Smile.」

93:t_1:44.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't know what happened to you, and I can't fix it. So I'll teach you how to find the strength to keep living.」

93:t_1:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「Put your heart into it. Smile, even when you're sad or hurting. The feeling'll follow.」

93:t_1:48.en:
$$ランド$$
「Turn it all around! Then you can face forward and keep going!」

93:t_1:51.en:
$$ランド$$
「et's do this, $n. If you're gonna save me, I'll save you, too」

93:t_1:57.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...I'll get straight to the conclusion.」

93:t_1:59.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「As I thought, you don't have $$トップレス$$.」

93:t_1:61.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Of course you don't. You're an android.」

93:t_1:62.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But you really can't tell by looking. Even your skin feels just like a normal girl's.」

93:t_1:64.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Listen... Why are you calling me Big Sis?」

93:t_1:65.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because you're a hero who protects everyone! Watching $$フラタニティ$$'s ace defeat $$宇宙怪獣$$ makes $$ノノ$$'s heart race!」

93:t_1:66.en:
$$チコ$$
「That ace spot will be mine soon, though.」

93:t_1:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ooh! Now that you pilot $$キャトフヴァンディス$$, you're full of confidence too, $$チコ$$!」

93:t_1:68.en:
$$チコ$$
「Honestly... Why did I have to compete with a girl like this to pilot $$キャトフヴァンディス$$...?」

93:t_1:69.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because they recognized $$ノノ$$'s hard work and guts...」

93:t_1:70.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No... I just thought it might be interesting.」

93:t_1:72.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$ produced more power than usual to save you.」

93:t_1:73.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I thought you might have something special that draws $$バスターマシン$$s to you.」

93:t_1:75.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's $$ノノ$$'s $$トップレス$$, isn't it!?」

93:t_1:76.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I told you, that's impossible! You're an android!」

93:t_1:77.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We can't rule it out, $$カシオ$$.」

93:t_1:78.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$トップレス$$ manifests advanced mental faculties. It's been suggested that an AI with self-awareness and intelligence could have it.」

93:t_1:79.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There just haven't been any actual examples.」

93:t_1:80.en:
$$チコ$$
「And you're saying this girl is an example?」

93:t_1:82.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you, $$ニコラ$$! $$ノノ$$ will work hard as a member of this 《$$フラタニティ$$》 with effort and guts!」

93:t_1:83.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I've let you stay here for now, but your job is to support us with the Machine Weapons, $$ノノ$$.」

93:t_1:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm still happy! I get to fight alongside Big Sis!」
